title: Technology | BLUCALM Gaming
description: Explore BLUCALM audio development, acoustic and mechanical testing, and electronics production.

hero.heading: From the bench to your setup.
hero.text: A look at the audio engineering, testing and production behind gaming headsets and desktop audio controls.
hero.imageAlt: An engineer probes a circuit board at an audio workstation with an oscilloscope
hero.caption: Audio development bench

sections.heading: The signal behind the sound.
sections.text: Digital signal processing lets us tune playback and shape microphone audio. On USB headset models with ENC, the microphone array helps reduce background noise in team chat.

photos.imageAlt: Illustration of a microchip and circuit traces lit in blue
photos.caption: Concept illustration · digital signal processing

photos.imageAlt: Headset sketches show how the headband and earcups fit
photos.caption: Headset fit and form studies

sections.heading: Check the sound. Check the hardware.
sections.text: Acoustic measurements help evaluate playback and microphone pickup. Mechanical checks can cover repeated connector insertion and movement of the headband or microphone boom, depending on the model.

photos.imageAlt: A head and torso acoustic test fixture in a treated room
photos.caption: Acoustic measurement setup

photos.imageAlt: An operator loads a production test station
photos.caption: Production test station

sections.heading: From the circuit board to assembly.
sections.text: Electronics production starts with the circuit board. Assembly and functional checks help verify that controls, connectors and audio work together before packing.
